message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s Department of Public Safety (the agency that handles noise violations). Here’s how:

| Method | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Phone** | Call the non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** (Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.). |
| **Online Form** | Complete the “Noise Complaint” form on the City’s website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department-of-public-safety/contact-us> |
| **In‑person** | Visit the City Hall at **101 Marietta St. NE, Atlanta, GA 30303** during business hours (Mon–Fri, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.). |

When filing, have the following ready:
* Exact location of the disturbance (address or intersection)
* Time(s) of the noise
* Description of the source (e.g., construction, party, loud music)
* Any evidence you may have (photos, videos, audio recordings)

The Department will review your complaint and, if warranted, dispatch officers to investigate. If the violation is confirmed, they can issue a citation under the city’s Noise Ordinance.
